extracted.intended_audience: applicants and patent practitioners preparing or prosecuting PCT international-phase applications
extracted.subtask_description: Using the PCT Applicant's Guide (International Phase) index to locate procedural requirements and substantive guidance for PCT international-phase prosecution (e.g., written opinions, date/publication numbering, and cross-referenced Articles/Rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Written opinion(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: WRITTEN OPINION(S) — defined; — of the ISA; — indicates claims not subject to IS; — not issued if no IPEA comments; amendments/arguments taken into account for — (10.028, 10.061, 10.068); applicant response to — (10.067-10.069); IPEA notifications/comments to applicant in — (10.064-10.065, 10.070, 11.047); multiple — (10.066-10.067). See INTERNATIONAL PRELIMINARY EXAMINATION.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index entry pointing to the Guide paragraphs that define and explain written opinions (including when they are issued, what they indicate about claims, how applicant responses and amendments are treated, and related IPEA notifications). Use the cited paragraph numbers (10.028, 10.061–10.071, 11.047, etc.) to read the full procedural/substantive rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Year/date indication (Y)
rubrics_metrics.description: YEAR Y — indication of — in dates (5.061).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index note that explains how year is indicated in dates within the Guide; consult paragraph 5.061 for the full rule/example of date formatting and the use of 'Y'.

rubrics_metrics.name: International publication number: contents/indications
rubrics_metrics.description: international publication number contains indication of — (9.015).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index pointer that the international publication number carries certain indicated information (see para. 9.015). Follow the referenced paragraph for details on what the publication number encodes and how it should be interpreted for priority/publication/date purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index of Articles, Rules and Administrative Instructions (cross-references)
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive index listing PCT Articles, PCT Rules, and Administrative Instructions with the Guide paragraph(s) in which each is discussed (e.g., Article 2(i) -> 5.002; Rule 4.1 -> 5.016; Section 102 -> 5.015, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page functions as a navigational rubric: for each PCT Article/Rule/Section cited, consult the corresponding paragraph(s) in the Guide for the substantive requirements and evaluation criteria. The index itself does not reproduce the standards but maps the legal provisions to the Guide paragraphs that explain application, exceptions, and procedural details.
